title: Release cutover checklist - 2026-03-06 (Riley scratchpad)
content:
Context / quick notes:
- Target release window: 2026-03-06 09:00-11:00 PT (primary). Keep team on standby 08:30. No user-visible downtime expected but short degraded latency for <5min possible during model warm-up and migration backfills.
- Release tag: v2026.03.06-cutover
- Primary owners: Riley (cutover lead), Jordan (db+migrations), Aisha (infra / autoscaling), Samira (monitoring / post-verify)
- Backport list: ENG-4500 (hotfix for kvcache eviction), ENG-4518 (s3 connector perf fix) -- ensure backports landed + smoke-tested in staging.

Pre-cutover (T-24h to T-1h) 
- [x] Ensure PRs merged and green: serving-runtime PRs listed in linked_artifacts.
- [x] Build artifacts uploaded to artifactory: check artifact v2026.03.06-* exists.
- [x] Staging release completed and sanity passed (perf smoke: 99th latency < 300ms).
- [x] Database backups: completed at 2026-03-05 23:15 PT (verified checksum).
- [ ] Confirm canaries and rollout policy ready in Console (Aisha) -- pinged at 07:50.
- [ ] Notify SOC/security about scheduled migration window (Samira to confirm email).
- [x] Pager rotations confirmed for today (oncall list pinned in #oncall).

Cutover runbook (live steps) 
0) Kickoff (09:00 PT) - Riley announces start in #release-cutover: include release tag, expected duration, and who to page for immediate rollback.
1) Freeze external deploys - request all teams to hold merges to main until cutover complete.
2) Deploy model-serving binary to dedicated workers (rolling restart):
   - stage rollout to 10% workers, wait 3m, run smoke-requests (health + sample prompts).
   - if smoke ok -> expand to 50%, wait 5m, run load test quick batch (samples from perf harness).
   - expand to 100% and monitor.
3) Run DB migrations (Jordan):
   - run migration ENG-4532-backport on worker-metadata DB in maintenance shard.
   - verify row counts and indexes (query snippets in Confluence page).
   - COMPLETION CHECK: migration finished and no locks > 30s.
4) Run backfill for prefix cache (optional if KV hitrate < 60%):
   - Run backfill job on batch cluster. Expect ~20 min for full set.
5) Update routing policy to prefer newer quantized variant for low-latency tier (Aisha).
6) Toggle feature-flag for new autoscaler (gradual 10% steps)
7) Post-deploy smoke tests (Samira):
   - run end-to-end chat flow (3 variants), measure latencies, token costs.
   - sanity check metrics: error rate < 0.5%, 99th latency within SLO.

Communication plan
- Pre-cutover announcement: 08:45 PT in #releases + email to product ops (template in Confluence).
- In-cutover updates: every 15m or on-blocking issue. Riley to post status updates in #release-cutover.
- Post-cutover: brief summary + any customer-impacting notes within 30m.

Rollback criteria & steps
- Rollback triggers: increase in error-rate > 1%, sustained 99th latency > 2x SLO for 15m, or critical regression in model outputs (quality alert from evals).
- Immediate actions: pause rollout, route traffic to previous model variant (Console -> routing -> fallback), re-run quick smoke tests, if unresolved -> full rollback to previous artifact (artifact manager -> promote previous tag), notify stakeholders.
- If DB migration caused problems: revert via rollback script (stored in Confluence, requires Jordan + DB lead).

Post-cutover (T+0m to T+24h)
- [ ] 30m: Sanity metrics snapshot + perf dashboard saved. (Samira)
- [ ] 1h: Confirm no increased error budgets and monitor for regressions.
- [ ] 6h: Run more thorough eval prompts set (quality monitoring) to detect subtle drifts.
- [ ] 24h: Postmortem draft (if any incidents) or short summary note.

Open / TODOs (notes to self)
- Need to confirm IAM key rotation timing; if rotation overlaps cutover -> get exception (TODO: contact security).
- Decide whether to run full KV backfill during cutover or schedule for low traffic window. Preference: postpone unless hitrate < 50%.
- Verify autoscaler policy will not trigger mass scale-down during rolling restart (Aisha to confirm).
- Add quick CLI commands to this doc for common rollback steps (save to Confluence after cutover).

Quick commands / snippets (placeholders)
- curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://console.redwood/api/healthz
- kubectl rollout status deployment/serving-runtime -n production
- gh pr view 987 --repo redwood-inference/serving-runtime

Notes to self (style: short)
- Keep updates concise. If more than 2 blocking issues -> call for incident channel.
- Trust the canary metrics: let them bake 5m minimum between expansions.
- If anything looks off -> immediate pause, triage, then decide rollback.

End of scratchpad. Will convert to formal checklist after cutover (copy to Confluence + mark final).
